+# AI RAG Guardrails Policy
+
+## Purpose
+
+This document defines guardrails for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
+systems deployed within the organization, covering prompt handling,
+context window hygiene, and output filtering.
+
+## Scope
+
+Applies to all internal LLM-backed assistants that retrieve from corporate
+knowledge bases.
+
+## Guardrails
+
+- Input sanitization on all user prompts
+- Retrieval source allowlist
+- Output filtering for sensitive categories
+- Rate limiting per principal
+- Logging of prompt/response pairs to the audit pipeline
